title.en: An Act Authorizing the Heirs or Representatives of the Late Lucercio Hofilea to Bring Suit Against the Government of the Philippine Islands and Directing the Attorney-General to Appear in Said Suit for Said Government.

text.en:
The heirs or legal representatives of the late Lucrecio Hofileña are hereby authorized to bring
suit within six months from and after the approval of this Act, in the Court of First Instance of Manila or
Iloilo, against the Government of the Philippines Islands, to show what right they have, if any, to any part of
the funds deposited in the year nineteen hundred in the Insular Treasury by the military authorities of the
United States as funds seized from the insurgent forces, on the behalf of the Government of the Philippine
Islands, to defend said Government.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 25, 1920.
